remaining_gap.description: Proctime MAP/MULTISET storage retains prior performance fallback. DISTINCT unchanged.

limits: These complete jobs include startup/source allocation, especially material for the short bounded profiles. No sustained-throughput or universal improvement claim.
Wide MULTISET gains can be modest and trial ranges overlap actual-prior execution. Paired prior stock controls are retained to expose process drift.

Native fixtures use default release codegen1 and allocation instrumentation; whole-job timings use the same frozen release+mimalloc DSO for both revisions. Allocation requests/buffer sharing are not copied bytes.
No new JNI, native operator or snapshot implementation; the new logical type uses existing validity-only counts and nullable-key list transport.
